issues.issue: The abstract says the multiple SC phases are distinguished by a single parameter, but at 0.3 K the ratio only separates SC1 from SC3. SC2 is never probed at base temperature and is located only through a minimum in the ratio versus temperature, compared with boundaries taken from other crystals. The headline sentence states more than the inset of Fig. 5a and Fig. S9 show.

evidence.quote: the multiple SC phases can be distinguished by a single parameter

issues.fix: State what the ratio actually does: its 0.3 K value differs between SC1 and SC3, and its temperature dependence has a minimum near the reported SC2-SC3 boundary. Call it a fitted gap ratio within the model.

edit.before: Quantitative analysis based on an extended Blonder-Tinkham-Klapwijk model unveils $B_{2u}$ or $B_{3u}$ as the most likely representation for both ambient and pressurized UTe$_2$, and remarkably, the multiple SC phases can be distinguished by a single parameter $\langle \Delta_{z}\rangle/\langle\Delta_{x(y)}\rangle$, the relative weight between the $p_z$-wave and $p_{x(y)}$-wave pairings.
edit.after: Within an extended Blonder-Tinkham-Klapwijk model, the spectra at all pressures are best described by the $B_{2u}$ or $B_{3u}$ representation, and the fitted gap ratio $\langle \Delta_{z}\rangle/\langle\Delta_{x(y)}\rangle$ at 0.3 K rises from about 0.6 in SC1 to between 1.0 and 1.3 in SC3, while at 0.6 to 1.2 GPa its temperature dependence shows a minimum close to the reported SC2-SC3 boundary.

issues.issue: The title asserts that the multiple phases are nodal, but the main text infers nodes only as a "high probability" from the ZBCP, concedes that Au (fully gapped) cannot be excluded at ambient pressure, and never measures SC2 at low temperature. The title is the strongest statement in the paper and is stronger than the text supports.

edit.after: Pressure evolution of Andreev bound state spectra and the superconducting order parameter in UTe$_2$

edit.after: Herein, by PCS measurements of UTe$_2$ under hydrostatic pressure, we observe zero-bias conductance peaks on the (0~0~1) surface that we attribute to ZABS, which suggests the presence of a $p_z$ component in the gap function.

issues.fix: End on what the data show: the order parameter changes across the pressure-induced phases and PCS can follow it in a pressure cell.

edit.before: Our work not only provides spectroscopic evidence for the existence of multiple SC phases in pressurized UTe$_2$, but also places critical constraints on its superconducting order parameter, thus collectively establishing UTe$_2$ as a prototypical system for studying intertwined electronic orders upon pressure tuning.
edit.after: Our work provides spectroscopic evidence that the superconducting order parameter of UTe$_2$ changes between the pressure-induced phases, and shows that point-contact spectroscopy can follow this change inside a pressure cell.
